body:
A historical callback pair finished editing but timed out waiting for Chromium's trace-completion event, leaving collection and cleanup incomplete. SPN-143 requests the same complete JSON trace over uncompressed protocol transport, stores it with bounded lossless Node gzip, and owns interruption, late stream handles, partial fixtures and final failure publication.

### ✅ Exact candidate and review

Source **`96b11bf0374540d28e5537d4a9cddb1280403e21`**, base **`eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`**, tested merge **`159aa2ab36bdb7313d6a2c7770b685512bf19216`**, equal source/tested tree **`9920742df8645f3d963ba5de1b5819efa9d1de7a`**. Independent nonimplementing pre-push reviews: **A98/100** (35/25/18/10/10), **B97/100** (35/25/17/10/10), both on that complete committed source with no unresolved source blockers. **Agent review only.** No product/UI change requires new visual-design approval.

**All selected current-source acceptance passed, and all four native owner audits are accepted.** The immutable [complete acceptance archive](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/77ae7264285ec7dae60883f7f103f88daea0d517/docs/review-assets/spn-143-acceptance-96b11bf0) retains both reviews, exact run/job/artifact identities, raw bytes and hashes, four independent native owner audits and final readiness findings. Local implementation/probe evidence remains [committed with the candidate](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96b11bf0374540d28e5537d4a9cddb1280403e21/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-143).

### 🔬 Supported behavior and limits

Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 puts browser gzip finalization on a background task path before tracingComplete. This identifies a dependency, **not the cause of the historical timeout**. One declared retained-trace probe established bounded local storage feasibility: 596,624,241 raw bytes retained with identical decoded SHA256, 47,129,287 stored bytes, 2.786s total, all streams closed. Watchdog3.043s/256,160KiB sampled combined peak, normal pressure; this is local cost, not native timing.

Complete JSON transport and stored Node gzip level1 have separate byte counts/hashes; the existing strict parser independently recomputes decoded identity and full source/lifetime attribution. Reads/compression/storage use backpressure and bounded chunks. Logarithmic byte progress retains early phases within the existing128-event journal. All capture categories, non-overwriting1GiB buffer, original2,086 inputs/content/caret/zoom/disposal, historical baseline `0e1df4725d9eccb77574d25e3eecdf678fe6ff44`, callback caps and **420-second deadline** remain unchanged.

Failure paths request one known stream close and start shared interruption without waiting on stalled IO, own late handles through session settlement, release pending reads on output failure and remove only owned partial files. Shared fixture closure covers partial/late acquisition and database closure. Timeout progress is persisted before cleanup; failed execution settles before republishing its manifest as failed. The comparator independently rejects missing/failed/timed-out terminal progress, so a stale passing write cannot override failure. The failure-only separate teardown allowance is reduced to30s; it does not extend successful acceptance or imply unconfirmed cleanup.

### 🧪 First-attempt hosted and local evidence

CI **41937955289 attempt1**: **all33 jobs and all seven required gates passed** (Pull request, Backlog, Lint, Typecheck, Unit tests, Lib tests, Playwright smoke). Storybook **41937955238 attempt1** passed all selected build/view/interaction checks; optional preview/main-only publication jobs follow their event/label conditions. The opened-event plan conservatively selected all15 suites because the immutable range or event labels were unavailable. No selected test was skipped. Full-project Typecheck passed, resolving the local focused-types limitation. Unit remaining includes589 Node controls, all passing. Digest-bound unit/library/browser aggregate records and their exact source/plan identities are retained in the archive.

Both callback pairs passed on their first attempts. Desktop job126951454527/artifact13375670977: baseline **211.749s**, candidate **195.147s**. Mobile job126951454700/artifact13377065196: baseline **401.258s**, candidate **313.378s**. The mobile baseline has only **18.742s** headroom under420s; no broad reliability guarantee is inferred. Each full trace's raw/stored identities and every source/map artifact were independently verified. Candidate pending caps are4/1/1, with zero target work after disposal and zero final pending. All native workload/content/caret/zoom/disposal checks and positive stream/session/fixture cleanup witnesses passed; journals retain successful terminal state without dropped events.

Trace completion still took **95.288/99.803s desktop** and **87.784/92.452s mobile** (baseline/candidate). These successes establish current end-to-end feasibility, **not that gzip caused the old timeout or that completion became faster**. Raw protocol transfer and larger stored output remain explicit costs. Heap samples without forced GC do not establish retained-object ownership; no hosted process-tree peak is claimed. Traced timing does not substitute for independent unprofiled responsiveness.

Both responsiveness pairs passed four baseline/seven candidate first attempts each. Desktop job126951454580/artifact13374893883: capacity maxima7.8/9.2/9.1ms, idle0.7/2.4/0.4ms, input p9530.3/29.6/29.7ms, drain301.6/303.2/301.5ms. Mobile job126951454507/artifact13377002708: capacity p9532.7/33.0/31.9ms and maxima45.8/48.1/49.3ms (unchanged50/100ms limits), idle2.6/2.6/4.0ms, input p95111.8/109.3/108.1ms, drain444.9/407.6/337.8ms. Native idle witnesses identify the actual drain owner, including policy-idle versus later empty timers. Full66-group Undo/Redo, exact sender/peer/saved content, continuation/composition and guest revocation passed on both presets. Profile clock uncertainty is343.0/342.4ms desktop and1893.5/1845.7ms mobile; negative/reordered samples remain disclosed. Exact candidate reducer-task attribution is unavailable, with no causal-speedup or physical-device claim.

Local **107/107** trace/progress/comparison/source/lifetime/CI-plan controls passed (2.889s,834,976KiB sampled peak), including real browserless Playwright timeout, real-database/fake-context partial cleanup, deferred final publication, rejected-end late handles and pending-read/output failure. Focused nine-root/import-graph types passed (444ms,292,688KiB); full lint/dependencies/format passed (17.752s,756,064KiB). Backlog/generated index/title/whitespace checks passed. Normal pressure throughout; short samples are not instantaneous peak measurements.

Early review found the final-write timeout race and rejected-end late-handle gap; both were fixed with controls before push. A first fixture test incorrectly queried a closed DB and caused a libsql panic; its corrected public isOpen witness passed and the failed log remains. Four expanded source tests exposed macOS /var versus canonical /private/var expectations; they now compare realpath of the same map, without changing production attribution/security. All attempts and resource dispositions remain in maintained evidence. Reviewer-script expectation corrections are separately recorded and did not rerun application acceptance.

### 📌 Original failure, scope and completion

The [original failed pair](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f/docs/review-assets/spn-142-first-candidate-2b173b29/receipt-runs) remains failed: CI41899145584/job126816804086, actual candidate13b74ece, baseline behavior348.004s, Tracing.end response348.014s, timeout420.046s awaiting completion. No baseline stream, attribution or owned-cleanup completion evidence was retained. Missing evidence does not prove browser error/data loss. SPN-134's diagnostic contract worked; later SPN-142 passes do not erase this reliability obligation.

[Maintained decisions and all four persona effects](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/96b11bf0374540d28e5537d4a9cddb1280403e21/docs/implementation/SPN-143.md) account for the complete **XL** investigation, persistence/provenance, cleanup, diagnostics, attribution, controls and integration/verification outcome. No assertion retry, reduced workload, broader deadline or incomplete-trace waiver was used. SPN-141, SPN-140 and SPN-120 still require fresh integrated-source acceptance after this prerequisite; no old green result substitutes for it.

The archive preserves both full raw traces and all attributed source/map files per preset as77 independently byte-verified original members, with original ZIP identities. The oversized callback ZIP containers and12 disposable SQLite files per pair are omitted explicitly. Complete original responsiveness ZIPs, logs, profiles and measurements remain. CI artifacts are supplementary and expire; the archive is commit-pinned.

**Merge and cleanup:** Squash merged as `5c565b61e11ce29780581f33410749436ecef42f`; its tree matches the reviewed/tested tree exactly. Remote implementation branch deletion was verified, no active PR owns it, and local implementation/tracking/helper refs were deleted with exact-head guards. The clean implementation worktree is detached at96b11bf0; root main is fast-forwarded to the squash. Immutable evidence tag is retained. Independent publication verification checked all263 manifest payloads/506,999,110 bytes and the exact264-blob archive; manifest SHA256 `f3cb260eb258afef382dbeaf7de07f29c485b02391c31b14bcb2ee920d5cd6b1`. Build/push/publication watchdogs passed with normal pressure; no access-blocked obsolete ref remains. The prior SPN-142 final-description run41934467037 was verified intentionally cancelled and retained in maintained evidence. This final description's own triggered validation will be separately inventoried and terminally accounted for without another body-edit loop.
